description: Session handoff: hand_off. Hand your own line, or an executor line of your goal as an adviser, to a new line whose duty follows the source, or an existing executor line. The source Run must have recorded an understanding note on a handed goal or stage anchor first; without one the result is incomplete and nothing is written. The result says whether the handoff is accepted, waiting for the person's approval, incomplete, or refused; it is not the handoff completing.

parameters.source: 必填：交出的 Session 线
parameters.assignments: Non-empty array of {target, tasks}: target is {kind:"create",duty:"executor"|"adviser"} or {kind:"existing",session}; every task must hold an open responsible link on the source
parameters.reason: Why this line is handed over
